# ============ 数据库 ============
POSTGRES_HOST=localhost
POSTGRES_PORT=5433
POSTGRES_DB=quarry
POSTGRES_USER=quarry
POSTGRES_PASSWORD=quarry-local-dev-2026

# ============ Redis ============
REDIS_HOST=localhost
REDIS_PORT=6380
REDIS_DB=0

# ============ 模型档位 ============
# 默认配的是阿里云百炼北京地域的 OpenAI 兼容接口。
# 换供应商只改这几行，业务代码一行不动。对照值见课件 2.3。
LLM_BASE_URL=https://dashscope.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1
LLM_API_KEY=sk-xxxx-REPLACE-ME

MODEL_EMBED=text-embedding-v4
EMBED_DIM=1024

# api = 真实调用；fake = 确定性哈希伪向量，不需要密钥
EMBED_BACKEND=api

# ============ 应用 ============
APP_ENV=development
LOG_LEVEL=INFO
DEFAULT_TOP_K=8

heads.3: 3.5 数据库扩展与初始迁移（Alembic）

context: 目录在 3.5.4 已经生成，不用再建。

-- 本章直接给的初始迁移。表结构的每个字段为什么存在，第二章讲。

CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector;

-- ============================ 租户 ============================
CREATE TABLE tenants (
  id          UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  slug        TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  name        TEXT NOT NULL,
  quota       JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  status      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
  created_at  TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

-- ============================ 集合 ============================
CREATE TABLE collections (
  id             UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  tenant_id      UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES tenants(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  slug           TEXT NOT NULL,
  name           TEXT NOT NULL,

  embed_model    TEXT NOT NULL,
  embed_dim      INT  NOT NULL,

  chunk_policy   JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  meta_schema    JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  abstain_config JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  default_acl_labels TEXT[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{public}',

  status         TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
  created_at     TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),

  CONSTRAINT collections_dim_ck CHECK (embed_dim = 1024)
);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX collections_one_active
  ON collections (tenant_id, slug) WHERE status = 'active';
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX collections_one_building
  ON collections (tenant_id, slug) WHERE status = 'building';

-- ============================ 文档 ============================
CREATE TABLE documents (
  id             UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  collection_id  UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES collections(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  source_uri     TEXT NOT NULL,
  archive_uri    TEXT,
  title          TEXT,
  sha256         TEXT NOT NULL,
  version        INT  NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,

  status         TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'uploaded',
  stage_error    TEXT,
  parser_tier    TEXT,

  meta           JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  acl_labels     TEXT[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  page_count     INT,
  created_at     TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  indexed_at     TIMESTAMPTZ,

  UNIQUE (collection_id, source_uri, version)
);

CREATE INDEX documents_by_status ON documents (collection_id, status);

-- ============================ 文本块 ============================
CREATE TABLE chunks (
  chunk_id      TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  document_id   UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES documents(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  collection_id UUID NOT NULL,
  doc_version   INT  NOT NULL,

  level         SMALLINT NOT NULL,       -- 0 = 父块，1 = 子块
  parent_id     TEXT,                    -- 子块指向父块；父块为 NULL
  ord           INT NOT NULL,

  heading_path  TEXT[],
  content       TEXT NOT NULL,
  char_start    INT NOT NULL,
  char_end      INT NOT NULL,

  tokens        TSVECTOR,
  embedding     halfvec(1024),

  acl_labels    TEXT[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  meta          JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  updated_at    TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),

  CONSTRAINT chunks_span_ck  CHECK (char_end > char_start),
  CONSTRAINT chunks_level_ck CHECK (level IN (0, 1)),
  CONSTRAINT chunks_parent_ck CHECK (
    (level = 1 AND parent_id IS NOT NULL) OR (level = 0 AND parent_id IS NULL)
  )
);

-- ============================ 索引 ============================
CREATE INDEX chunks_embed_hnsw ON chunks
  USING hnsw (embedding halfvec_cosine_ops)
  WITH (m = 16, ef_construction = 64)
  WHERE level = 1;

CREATE INDEX chunks_tokens_gin ON chunks
  USING gin (tokens) WHERE level = 1;

CREATE INDEX chunks_acl_gin ON chunks USING gin (acl_labels);

CREATE INDEX chunks_meta_gin ON chunks USING gin (meta jsonb_path_ops);

CREATE INDEX chunks_scope ON chunks (collection_id, doc_version, level);

CREATE INDEX chunks_parent ON chunks (parent_id) WHERE level = 1;

CREATE INDEX chunks_neighbors ON chunks (document_id, heading_path, ord)
  WHERE level = 0;
💡 这份表结构第二章、第五章还会各改一次（块主键、邻块索引），每次都是写一个新迁移，而不是回来改这个文件。
已经执行过的迁移文件永远不要再改

  level         SMALLINT NOT NULL,       -- 0 = 父块，1 = 子块
  parent_id     TEXT,                    -- 子块指向父块；父块为 NULL
  ord           INT NOT NULL,

  heading_path  TEXT[],
  content       TEXT NOT NULL,
  char_start    INT NOT NULL,
  char_end      INT NOT NULL,

  tokens        TSVECTOR,
  embedding     halfvec(1024),

  acl_labels    TEXT[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  meta          JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  updated_at    TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),

  CONSTRAINT chunks_span_ck  CHECK (char_end > char_start),
  CONSTRAINT chunks_level_ck CHECK (level IN (0, 1)),
  CONSTRAINT chunks_parent_ck CHECK (
    (level = 1 AND parent_id IS NOT NULL) OR (level = 0 AND parent_id IS NULL)
  )
);

-- ============================ 索引 ============================
CREATE INDEX chunks_embed_hnsw ON chunks
  USING hnsw (embedding halfvec_cosine_ops)
  WITH (m = 16, ef_construction = 64)
  WHERE level = 1;

CREATE INDEX chunks_tokens_gin ON chunks
  USING gin (tokens) WHERE level = 1;

CREATE INDEX chunks_acl_gin ON chunks USING gin (acl_labels);

CREATE INDEX chunks_meta_gin ON chunks USING gin (meta jsonb_path_ops);

CREATE INDEX chunks_scope ON chunks (collection_id, doc_version, level);

CREATE INDEX chunks_parent ON chunks (parent_id) WHERE level = 1;

CREATE INDEX chunks_neighbors ON chunks (document_id, heading_path, ord)
  WHERE level = 0;

"""启动期自检。五项都是 ✅ 才算环境打通。"""
import asyncio
import sys

import asyncpg
import redis.asyncio as aioredis

from quarry.infra.settings import get_settings

MIN_PGVECTOR = (0, 8, 2)

def _parse(v: str) -> tuple[int, ...]:
    return tuple(int(x) for x in v.split(".")[:3])

async def main() -> int:
    s = get_settings()
    print("配置加载：")
    print(f"   postgres = {s.postgres_host}:{s.postgres_port}/{s.postgres_db}")
    print(f"   redis    = {s.redis_host}:{s.redis_port}")
    print(f"   api_key  = {s.llm_api_key}")      # SecretStr 自动脱敏
    print(f"   embed    = {s.model_embed} / {s.embed_dim} 维 / 后端 {s.embed_backend}")
    print(f"   app_env  = {s.app_env}")
    print()

    ok = True

    # ① Postgres 连通
    try:
        conn = await asyncpg.connect(s.dsn, timeout=5)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ Postgres 连不上：{e!r}")
        print("   先跑 docker compose ps，确认 postgres 是 (healthy)；再检查 .env 里的端口和密码")
        return 1
    try:
        ver = await conn.fetchval("SELECT version()")
        print(f"✅ Postgres 连通：{ver[:45]}...")

        # ② pgvector 扩展版本
        ext = await conn.fetchval(
            "SELECT extversion FROM pg_extension WHERE extname = 'vector'")
        if ext is None:
            print("❌ pgvector 扩展未安装。检查 docker/init-db.sql，"
                  "或者进 psql 手动执行 CREATE EXTENSION vector;")
            ok = False
        elif _parse(ext) < MIN_PGVECTOR:
            print(f"❌ pgvector {ext} 低于要求的 {'.'.join(map(str, MIN_PGVECTOR))}")
            ok = False
        else:
            print(f"✅ pgvector 版本：{ext}")

        # ③ 表是否建好
        if await conn.fetchval("SELECT to_regclass('chunks') IS NOT NULL"):
            print("✅ 迁移已跑：chunks 表存在")
        else:
            print("❌ chunks 表不存在。跑 uv run alembic upgrade head")
            ok = False
    finally:
        await conn.close()

    # ④ Redis 连通
    r = aioredis.from_url(s.redis_url, socket_connect_timeout=5)
    try:
        print(f"✅ Redis 连通：ping = {await r.ping()}")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ Redis 连不上：{e!r}")
        ok = False
    finally:
        await r.aclose()

    # ⑤ 向量化接口连通，且维度和配置一致
    from quarry.infra.embed import get_embedder
    try:
        vec = (await get_embedder().embed(["连通性测试"]))[0]
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ 向量化接口调用失败：{e!r}")
        print("   检查 LLM_API_KEY、LLM_BASE_URL；没有 key 可以先把 EMBED_BACKEND 改成 fake")
        return 1
    if len(vec) != s.embed_dim:
        print(f"❌ 向量维度不一致：模型返回 {len(vec)}，配置是 {s.embed_dim}")
        ok = False
    elif s.embed_backend == "fake":
        print(f"⚠️  向量化用的是 fake 后端（{len(vec)} 维），检索结果没有语义意义。"
              f"第二章开始把 EMBED_BACKEND 改回 api。")
    else:
        print(f"✅ 向量化接口连通：{s.model_embed} 返回 {len(vec)} 维")

    return 0 if ok else 1

if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(asyncio.run(main()))

"""文本归一化。全项目唯一的一份。"""
import re
import unicodedata

_WS = re.compile(r"\s+")

def normalize(text: str) -> str:
    """统一全角半角、压缩连续空白、去掉首尾空格。

    调用点（全项目只允许调用这一份）：
    - quarry.common.ids.make_chunk_id 生成块标识时
    - 第三章写入 tokens 前的预处理
    - 第四章处理查询词时

    注意：只用于"计算"，不要用它改写要存进 content 的原文。

    ⚠️ 修改这个函数的规则，会让所有已有块标识失效。修改前必须准备好全量重建。
    """
    t = unicodedata.normalize("NFKC", text)   # 全角 １２０ → 120，全角 ： → :
    t = _WS.sub(" ", t)                       # 连续空白（含换行、制表符）→ 一个空格
    return t.strip()

    t = _WS.sub(" ", t)                       # 连续空白（含换行、制表符）→ 一个空格
    return t.strip()

"""验证 make_chunk_id 的必要性质：

1. 确定性：同样的输入，同样的输出
2. 归一化：全角半角、多余空白不影响结果
3. 区分性：内容不同、标题不同，结果就不同
4. 无歧义：标题路径的拼接不会把两种不同的路径算成一个
5. 跨进程稳定：新开一个 Python 进程算，结果和本进程相同
"""
import subprocess
import sys

from quarry.common.ids import make_chunk_id

BASE = ("travel-guide", "xian-guide.md", ["必游景点", "兵马俑博物馆"], "门票 120 元")

def check_deterministic():
    a = make_chunk_id(*BASE)
    b = make_chunk_id(*BASE)
    assert a == b, f"同一进程内两次结果不同: {a} vs {b}"
    print(f"✅ 确定性:同样的输入 → {a}")

def check_normalization():
    a = make_chunk_id("travel-guide", "xian-guide.md",
                      ["必游景点", "兵马俑博物馆"], "门票 １２０ 元")
    b = make_chunk_id(*BASE)
    assert a == b, f"归一化没生效: {a} vs {b}"
    print("✅ 归一化:全角「１２０」和半角「120」→ 同一个 ID")

def check_content_matters():
    a = make_chunk_id(*BASE)
    b = make_chunk_id("travel-guide", "xian-guide.md",
                      ["必游景点", "兵马俑博物馆"], "门票 130 元")
    assert a != b, "内容不同却算出了相同的 ID"
    print("✅ 区分性:内容不同 → ID 不同")

def check_heading_matters():
    a = make_chunk_id("travel-guide", "xian-guide.md", ["大雁塔"], "详见官网")
    b = make_chunk_id("travel-guide", "xian-guide.md", ["华清宫"], "详见官网")
    assert a != b, "heading_path 没有参与计算"
    print("✅ 区分性:内容相同、标题不同 → ID 不同")

def check_path_separator():
    a = make_chunk_id("travel-guide", "visa.md", ["出入境/签证"], "详见官网")
    b = make_chunk_id("travel-guide", "visa.md", ["出入境", "签证"], "详见官网")
    assert a != b, "标题路径拼接有歧义"
    print('✅ 无歧义:["出入境/签证"] 和 ["出入境", "签证"] → ID 不同')

def check_cross_process():
    here = make_chunk_id(*BASE)
    code = (
        "from quarry.common.ids import make_chunk_id;"
        "print(make_chunk_id('travel-guide', 'xian-guide.md',"
        " ['必游景点', '兵马俑博物馆'], '门票 120 元'))"
    )
    there = subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, "-c", code],
        capture_output=True, text=True, check=True,
    ).stdout.strip()
    assert here == there, f"跨进程不一致: 本进程={here} 新进程={there}"
    print(f"✅ 跨进程稳定:新开一个 Python 进程也算出 {there}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    check_deterministic()
    check_normalization()
    check_content_matters()
    check_heading_matters()
    check_path_separator()
    check_cross_process()
    print("\n全部通过。这个函数可以放心用作块标识。")

"""试跑切分器，顺带校验区间。"""
import sys
from pathlib import Path

from quarry.ingest.parsers import get_parser
from quarry.ingest.splitter import split

def main(target: str) -> None:
    path = Path(target)
    raw = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    parser = get_parser(str(path))

    bad = 0
    for section in parser.parse(path):
        parent, children = split(section)
        print(f"\n📄 父块 {' > '.join(parent.heading_path) or '(无标题)'}")
        print(f"   [{parent.char_start}, {parent.char_end}] 长度 {len(parent.content)}")
        for c in children:
            ok = raw[c.char_start:c.char_end] == c.content
            inside = (c.char_start >= parent.char_start
                      and c.char_end <= parent.char_end)
            if not (ok and inside):
                bad += 1
            mark = "✅" if ok and inside else "❌"
            print(f"   └─ 子块 #{c.ord} {mark} [{c.char_start}, {c.char_end}] "
                  f"长度 {len(c.content)}")
            print(f"      {c.content[:40]}...")

    print(f"\n区间校验：{'全部通过' if bad == 0 else f'{bad} 个有问题'}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "corpus/travel-guide/丽江.md")

"""挑一份已经在库里的文档，扔进队列。"""
import asyncio

from quarry.infra.db import acquire, close_pool, init_pool
from quarry.ingest.queue import enqueue_document, ensure_group

async def main() -> None:
    await init_pool()
    try:
        await ensure_group()
        async with acquire() as conn:
            doc_id = await conn.fetchval(
                "SELECT id FROM documents WHERE status = 'ready' LIMIT 1")
        if doc_id is None:
            print("库里还没有 ready 的文档，先跑 ingest_corpus")
            return
        msg_id = await enqueue_document(doc_id)
        print(f"入队 {msg_id}，文档 {doc_id}")
    finally:
        await close_pool()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())

"""导出集合的索引快照。

产物：
    snapshots/<集合>/collection.json      集合元信息（模型、维度、切分策略）
    snapshots/<集合>/documents.jsonl.gz   文档表
    snapshots/<集合>/chunks.jsonl.gz      块表（不含向量）
    snapshots/<集合>/manifest.json        以上三个文件的 sha256
    snapshots/<集合>/build-info.json      导出时间，不进清单
"""
import asyncio
import gzip
import hashlib
import json
import sys
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

from quarry.infra.db import acquire, close_pool, init_pool

MANIFESTED = ("collection.json", "documents.jsonl.gz", "chunks.jsonl.gz")

def as_dict(v) -> dict:
    """JSONB 列可能是 dict / str / None，统一成 dict。"""
    if v is None:
        return {}
    if isinstance(v, str):
        return json.loads(v)
    return dict(v)

def write_jsonl_gz(path: Path, rows) -> None:
    """写一个可复现的 gzip 文件。

    gzip 头部默认会带上当前时间戳，同样的内容两次导出会得到不同的字节，
    校验和也就跟着变。mtime=0 把这个时间戳固定下来。
    """
    with path.open("wb") as raw, \
            gzip.GzipFile(fileobj=raw, mode="wb", mtime=0) as gz:
        for row in rows:
            gz.write((json.dumps(row, ensure_ascii=False,
                                 sort_keys=True) + "\n").encode("utf-8"))

async def export_collection(coll_slug: str, out_dir: Path) -> None:
    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    async with acquire() as conn:
        coll = await conn.fetchrow(
            "SELECT * FROM collections WHERE slug = $1 AND status = 'active'",
            coll_slug)
        if coll is None:
            raise ValueError(f"没有 active 集合 {coll_slug}")

        # 这个文件进清单，所以里面不能有导出时间这种每次都变的东西
        (out_dir / "collection.json").write_text(json.dumps({
            "slug": coll["slug"],
            "embed_model": coll["embed_model"],
            "embed_dim": coll["embed_dim"],
            "chunk_policy": as_dict(coll["chunk_policy"]),
        }, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, sort_keys=True), encoding="utf-8")

        docs = await conn.fetch(
            """SELECT id, source_uri, title, sha256, version, acl_labels, meta
               FROM documents
               WHERE collection_id = $1 AND status = 'ready'
               ORDER BY source_uri, version""", coll["id"])
        write_jsonl_gz(out_dir / "documents.jsonl.gz", [{
            "id": str(d["id"]), "source_uri": d["source_uri"],
            "title": d["title"], "sha256": d["sha256"], "version": d["version"],
            "acl_labels": list(d["acl_labels"]), "meta": as_dict(d["meta"]),
        } for d in docs])

        chunks = await conn.fetch(
            """SELECT chunk_id, document_id, level, parent_id, ord,
                      heading_path, content, char_start, char_end,
                      acl_labels, meta
               FROM chunks WHERE collection_id = $1
               ORDER BY chunk_id""", coll["id"])
        write_jsonl_gz(out_dir / "chunks.jsonl.gz", [{
            "chunk_id": c["chunk_id"], "document_id": str(c["document_id"]),
            "level": c["level"], "parent_id": c["parent_id"], "ord": c["ord"],
            "heading_path": list(c["heading_path"] or []),
            "content": c["content"],
            "char_start": c["char_start"], "char_end": c["char_end"],
            "acl_labels": list(c["acl_labels"]), "meta": as_dict(c["meta"]),
        } for c in chunks])

    manifest = {name: hashlib.sha256((out_dir / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
                for name in MANIFESTED}
    (out_dir / "manifest.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(manifest, indent=2, sort_keys=True), encoding="utf-8")

    # 导出时间单独放一个文件，不进清单
    (out_dir / "build-info.json").write_text(json.dumps({
        "exported_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        "documents": len(docs),
        "chunks": len(chunks),
    }, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")

    print(f"快照导出到 {out_dir}")
    print(f"  documents {len(docs)}")
    print(f"  chunks    {len(chunks)}")

async def main() -> None:
    slug = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "travel-guide"
    await init_pool()
    try:
        await export_collection(slug, Path("snapshots") / slug)
    finally:
        await close_pool()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())

    snapshots/<集合>/build-info.json      导出时间，不进清单
"""
import asyncio
import gzip
import hashlib
import json
import sys
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

from quarry.infra.db import acquire, close_pool, init_pool

MANIFESTED = ("collection.json", "documents.jsonl.gz", "chunks.jsonl.gz")

def as_dict(v) -> dict:
    """JSONB 列可能是 dict / str / None，统一成 dict。"""
    if v is None:
        return {}
    if isinstance(v, str):
        return json.loads(v)
    return dict(v)

def write_jsonl_gz(path: Path, rows) -> None:
    """写一个可复现的 gzip 文件。

    gzip 头部默认会带上当前时间戳，同样的内容两次导出会得到不同的字节，
    校验和也就跟着变。mtime=0 把这个时间戳固定下来。
    """
    with path.open("wb") as raw, \
            gzip.GzipFile(fileobj=raw, mode="wb", mtime=0) as gz:
        for row in rows:
            gz.write((json.dumps(row, ensure_ascii=False,
                                 sort_keys=True) + "\n").encode("utf-8"))

async def export_collection(coll_slug: str, out_dir: Path) -> None:
    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    async with acquire() as conn:
        coll = await conn.fetchrow(
            "SELECT * FROM collections WHERE slug = $1 AND status = 'active'",
            coll_slug)
        if coll is None:
            raise ValueError(f"没有 active 集合 {coll_slug}")

        # 这个文件进清单，所以里面不能有导出时间这种每次都变的东西
        (out_dir / "collection.json").write_text(json.dumps({
            "slug": coll["slug"],
            "embed_model": coll["embed_model"],
            "embed_dim": coll["embed_dim"],
            "chunk_policy": as_dict(coll["chunk_policy"]),
        }, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, sort_keys=True), encoding="utf-8")

        docs = await conn.fetch(
            """SELECT id, source_uri, title, sha256, version, acl_labels, meta
               FROM documents
               WHERE collection_id = $1 AND status = 'ready'
               ORDER BY source_uri, version""", coll["id"])
        write_jsonl_gz(out_dir / "documents.jsonl.gz", [{
            "id": str(d["id"]), "source_uri": d["source_uri"],
            "title": d["title"], "sha256": d["sha256"], "version": d["version"],
            "acl_labels": list(d["acl_labels"]), "meta": as_dict(d["meta"]),
        } for d in docs])

        chunks = await conn.fetch(
            """SELECT chunk_id, document_id, level, parent_id, ord,
                      heading_path, content, char_start, char_end,
                      acl_labels, meta
               FROM chunks WHERE collection_id = $1
               ORDER BY chunk_id""", coll["id"])
        write_jsonl_gz(out_dir / "chunks.jsonl.gz", [{
            "chunk_id": c["chunk_id"], "document_id": str(c["document_id"]),
            "level": c["level"], "parent_id": c["parent_id"], "ord": c["ord"],
            "heading_path": list(c["heading_path"] or []),
            "content": c["content"],
            "char_start": c["char_start"], "char_end": c["char_end"],
            "acl_labels": list(c["acl_labels"]), "meta": as_dict(c["meta"]),
        } for c in chunks])

    manifest = {name: hashlib.sha256((out_dir / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
                for name in MANIFESTED}
    (out_dir / "manifest.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(manifest, indent=2, sort_keys=True), encoding="utf-8")

    # 导出时间单独放一个文件，不进清单
    (out_dir / "build-info.json").write_text(json.dumps({
        "exported_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        "documents": len(docs),
        "chunks": len(chunks),
    }, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")

    print(f"快照导出到 {out_dir}")
    print(f"  documents {len(docs)}")
    print(f"  chunks    {len(chunks)}")

async def main() -> None:
    slug = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "travel-guide"
    await init_pool()
    try:
        await export_collection(slug, Path("snapshots") / slug)
    finally:
        await close_pool()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())

--   $5  query_tsquery   TEXT       Python 端拼好的 OR 表达式
--   $6  dense_k         INT        向量路取多少候选
--   $7  sparse_k        INT        全文路取多少候选
--   $8  weight_dense    FLOAT8
--   $9  weight_sparse   FLOAT8
--   $10 rrf_k           INT        RRF 的衰减常数，常用 60
--   $11 top_k           INT        最终返回多少
--
-- ⚠️ 四个过滤条件在两个子查询里各写一遍，不要提成共享 CTE。原因见 4.3.2。

WITH dense AS (
  -- 先用 HNSW 索引取前 dense_k 名，再给这几十行编号。
  -- 编号放在外层，是为了让内层那个 ORDER BY ... LIMIT 能被索引直接满足。
  SELECT chunk_id,
         row_number() OVER (ORDER BY dist) AS rk,
         dist
  FROM (
    SELECT chunk_id,
           embedding <=> $4::halfvec(1024) AS dist
    FROM chunks
    WHERE collection_id = $1
      AND level         = 1
      AND acl_labels   && $2::text[]
      AND meta          @> $3::jsonb
    ORDER BY embedding <=> $4::halfvec(1024)
    LIMIT $6
  ) d
),
sparse AS (
  SELECT chunk_id,
         row_number() OVER (ORDER BY ts_score DESC) AS rk,
         ts_score
  FROM (
    SELECT chunk_id,
           ts_rank_cd(tokens, to_tsquery('simple', $5)) AS ts_score
    FROM chunks
    WHERE collection_id = $1
      AND level         = 1
      AND acl_labels   && $2::text[]
      AND meta          @> $3::jsonb
      AND tokens        @@ to_tsquery('simple', $5)
    ORDER BY ts_rank_cd(tokens, to_tsquery('simple', $5)) DESC
    LIMIT $7
  ) s
),
merged AS (
  -- FULL OUTER JOIN 保证两路的并集都进入打分。
  -- USING 的连接列在 FULL JOIN 下自动取两边的非空值，不用再写 COALESCE。
  SELECT chunk_id,
         COALESCE($8::float8 / ($10::int + d.rk), 0)
       + COALESCE($9::float8 / ($10::int + s.rk), 0) AS score,
         d.rk       AS dense_rank,
         s.rk       AS sparse_rank,
         d.dist     AS dense_dist,
         s.ts_score AS sparse_score
  FROM dense d
  FULL OUTER JOIN sparse s USING (chunk_id)
)
SELECT c.chunk_id, c.document_id, c.parent_id,
       c.heading_path, c.content, c.char_start, c.char_end,
       m.score, m.dense_rank, m.sparse_rank,
       1 - m.dense_dist AS dense_score,
       m.sparse_score
FROM merged m
JOIN chunks c
  ON c.collection_id = $1        -- ⚠️ 这一行少不得，原因见 4.3.4 第 ④ 点
 AND c.chunk_id      = m.chunk_id
ORDER BY m.score DESC
LIMIT $11;

"""CPU 密集任务专用线程池。"""
from __future__ import annotations

import atexit
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor

_executor: ThreadPoolExecutor | None = None

def get_cpu_executor() -> ThreadPoolExecutor:
    global _executor
    if _executor is None:
        _executor = ThreadPoolExecutor(
            max_workers=8, thread_name_prefix="quarry-cpu")
        atexit.register(shutdown_executor)
    return _executor

def shutdown_executor() -> None:
    global _executor
    if _executor is not None:
        _executor.shutdown(wait=True)
        _executor = None

"""PostgreSQL 检索实现。"""
from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
from pathlib import Path
from uuid import UUID

from quarry.common.vectors import to_halfvec_literal
from quarry.infra.db import acquire
from quarry.infra.embed import get_embedder
from quarry.infra.executor import get_cpu_executor
from quarry.retrieval.base import Hit
from quarry.retrieval.query import build_tsquery

_SQL_DIR = Path(__file__).parent / "sql"
_HYBRID_SQL = (_SQL_DIR / "hybrid_search.sql").read_text(encoding="utf-8")

async def hybrid_search(
    collection_id: UUID,
    query: str,
    caller_labels: list[str],
    meta_filter: dict | None = None,
    dense_k: int = 50,
    sparse_k: int = 50,
    weight_dense: float = 0.5,
    weight_sparse: float = 0.5,
    rrf_k: int = 60,
    top_k: int = 10,
) -> list[Hit]:
    """混合检索，返回按融合分数排序的命中列表。"""
    meta_filter = meta_filter or {}
    loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()

    # 向量化是网络 I/O，分词是 CPU，两件事同时做。
    # 分词丢进线程池的原因见 4.7。
    qvec_list, tsq = await asyncio.gather(
        get_embedder().embed([query]),
        loop.run_in_executor(get_cpu_executor(), build_tsquery, query),
    )
    vec_lit = to_halfvec_literal(qvec_list[0])

    async with acquire() as conn, conn.transaction():
        # SET LOCAL 只在本事务内生效，不会污染连接池里的这条连接。
        # 为什么要开迭代扫描，见 4.5。
        await conn.execute("SET LOCAL hnsw.iterative_scan = relaxed_order")
        await conn.execute("SET LOCAL hnsw.max_scan_tuples = 20000")
        rows = await conn.fetch(
            _HYBRID_SQL,
            collection_id, caller_labels, meta_filter, vec_lit, tsq,
            dense_k, sparse_k, weight_dense, weight_sparse, rrf_k, top_k,
        )

    return [Hit(
        chunk_id=r["chunk_id"],
        document_id=r["document_id"],
        parent_id=r["parent_id"],
        heading_path=list(r["heading_path"] or []),
        content=r["content"],
        char_start=r["char_start"],
        char_end=r["char_end"],
        score=float(r["score"]),
        dense_rank=r["dense_rank"],
        sparse_rank=r["sparse_rank"],
        dense_score=float(r["dense_score"]) if r["dense_score"] is not None else None,
        sparse_score=float(r["sparse_score"]) if r["sparse_score"] is not None else None,
    ) for r in rows]

class PgRetriever:
    """把 hybrid_search 包成符合 Retriever 协议的对象。见 4.6。"""

    async def search(
        self,
        collection_id: UUID,
        query: str,
        caller_labels: list[str],
        meta_filter: dict | None = None,
        top_k: int = 10,
    ) -> list[Hit]:
        return await hybrid_search(
            collection_id=collection_id, query=query,
            caller_labels=caller_labels, meta_filter=meta_filter, top_k=top_k)

取到多大时能"碰到"几个稀有块，是可以算出来的，实验结果每个人都一样。

"""造一批数据，把强过滤下的漏召回现象跑出来。

思路：给每个块预先分配一个"离查询向量的名次"，把 10 个稀有标签块
均匀撒在第 50～850 名之间。iterative_scan=off 时 HNSW 只拿前 ef_search 个
候选再过滤，所以 ef_search 从 40 调到 1000，返回条数会从 0 逐步补到 10。

做完会把造的数据清掉，不影响你现有的语料。
"""
import asyncio
import math
import random

from quarry.common.vectors import to_halfvec_literal
from quarry.infra.db import acquire, close_pool, init_pool

N_TOTAL = 5000
DIM = 1024
BATCH = 500
TOP_K = 10

# 稀有标签块的名次（0 起算），名次越小离查询越近
RARE_POSITIONS = [50, 120, 180, 250, 350, 450, 550, 650, 750, 850]
EF_LIST = [40, 100, 150, 200, 300, 400, 500, 600, 700, 800, 900, 1000]

SIM_TOP = 0.95      # 第 0 名与查询的余弦相似度
SIM_SPAN = 0.90     # 最后一名的相似度 = SIM_TOP - SIM_SPAN = 0.05

def unit(vec):
    n = math.sqrt(sum(v * v for v in vec)) or 1.0
    return [v / n for v in vec]

def make_vec(q, sim, rng):
    """构造一个与 q 的余弦相似度恰好为 sim 的单位向量。"""
    u = [rng.gauss(0, 1) for _ in range(DIM)]
    dot = sum(a * b for a, b in zip(u, q))
    u = unit([a - dot * b for a, b in zip(u, q)])      # 去掉 q 方向的分量
    ortho = math.sqrt(max(0.0, 1 - sim * sim))
    return unit([sim * a + ortho * b for a, b in zip(q, u)])

async def setup(conn):
    tenant_id = await conn.fetchval(
        """INSERT INTO tenants (slug, name) VALUES ('stress', '压测租户')
           ON CONFLICT (slug) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name
           RETURNING id""")
    coll_id = await conn.fetchval(
        """INSERT INTO collections (tenant_id, slug, name, embed_model, embed_dim)
           VALUES ($1, 'stress', '压测集合', 'synthetic', 1024)
           ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, slug) WHERE status = 'active'
           DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name
           RETURNING id""", tenant_id)
    doc_id = await conn.fetchval(
        """INSERT INTO documents (collection_id, source_uri, sha256, status)
           VALUES ($1, 'synthetic.md', 'x', 'ready')
           ON CONFLICT (collection_id, source_uri, version)
           DO UPDATE SET status = 'ready'
           RETURNING id""", coll_id)

    await conn.execute("DELETE FROM chunks WHERE collection_id = $1", coll_id)

    rng = random.Random(42)
    q = unit([rng.gauss(0, 1) for _ in range(DIM)])
    rare_set = set(RARE_POSITIONS)

    # 打乱插入顺序，避免"按相似度顺序插入"影响 HNSW 建图
    order = list(range(N_TOTAL))
    rng.shuffle(order)

    sql = """INSERT INTO chunks (chunk_id, document_id, collection_id, doc_version,
                                 level, parent_id, ord, heading_path, content,
                                 char_start, char_end, acl_labels, embedding)
             VALUES ($1, $2, $3, 1, 1, 'synthetic-parent', $4, ARRAY['压测'],
                     $5, 0, 1, $6, $7::halfvec(1024))"""
    batch = []
    for n, pos in enumerate(order, 1):
        sim = SIM_TOP - SIM_SPAN * pos / (N_TOTAL - 1)
        vec = make_vec(q, sim, rng)
        labels = ["org:tiny-team"] if pos in rare_set else ["public"]
        batch.append((f"stress-{pos:06d}", doc_id, coll_id, pos, "x",
                      labels, to_halfvec_literal(vec)))
        if len(batch) >= BATCH:
            await conn.executemany(sql, batch)
            batch.clear()
            print(f"  已写入 {n} / {N_TOTAL}")
    if batch:
        await conn.executemany(sql, batch)

    return coll_id, to_halfvec_literal(q)

PROBE_SQL = """
SELECT chunk_id FROM chunks
WHERE collection_id = $1 AND level = 1
  AND acl_labels && ARRAY['org:tiny-team']::text[]
ORDER BY embedding <=> $2::halfvec(1024)
LIMIT $3
"""

async def exact_rare_ranks(conn, coll_id, qvec):
    """精确计算稀有块在本集合里的名次（1 起算）。"""
    rows = await conn.fetch(
        """WITH ranked AS (
             SELECT acl_labels,
                    row_number() OVER (ORDER BY embedding <=> $2::halfvec(1024)) AS rn
             FROM chunks WHERE collection_id = $1 AND level = 1)
           SELECT rn FROM ranked
           WHERE acl_labels && ARRAY['org:tiny-team']::text[]
           ORDER BY rn""", coll_id, qvec)
    return [r["rn"] for r in rows]

async def probe(conn, coll_id, qvec, scan_mode, ef_search):
    """强制走 HNSW，返回 (实际条数, 扫描方式)。"""
    async with conn.transaction():
        await conn.execute(f"SET LOCAL hnsw.iterative_scan = {scan_mode}")
        await conn.execute(f"SET LOCAL hnsw.ef_search = {ef_search}")
        await conn.execute("SET LOCAL hnsw.max_scan_tuples = 20000")
        # 堵死顺序扫描和"GIN 过滤后再排序"这两条路，只剩 HNSW
        await conn.execute("SET LOCAL enable_seqscan = off")
        await conn.execute("SET LOCAL enable_bitmapscan = off")
        await conn.execute("SET LOCAL enable_sort = off")

        plan_rows = await conn.fetch("EXPLAIN " + PROBE_SQL, coll_id, qvec, TOP_K)
        plan = "\n".join(r[0] for r in plan_rows)
        used = "HNSW" if "hnsw" in plan.lower() else "其他"

        rows = await conn.fetch(PROBE_SQL, coll_id, qvec, TOP_K)
    return len(rows), used

async def main():
    await init_pool()
    try:
        async with acquire() as conn:
            try:
                print("造数据中，大约需要一分钟")
                coll_id, qvec = await setup(conn)
                await conn.execute("ANALYZE chunks")
                print(f"造好了，{N_TOTAL} 个块，其中 {len(RARE_POSITIONS)} 个带 org:tiny-team\n")

                ranks = await exact_rare_ranks(conn, coll_id, qvec)
                print(f"稀有块的精确名次：{ranks}\n")

                print(f"{'iterative_scan':<16}{'ef_search':<11}{'扫描':<7}"
                      f"{'理论':<7}{'实际':<7}")
                print("-" * 50)
                for ef in EF_LIST:
                    expect = min(TOP_K, sum(1 for r in ranks if r <= ef))
                    n, used = await probe(conn, coll_id, qvec, "off", ef)
                    bar = "█" * n + "·" * (TOP_K - n)
                    print(f"{'off':<16}{ef:<11}{used:<7}{expect:<7}{n:<7}{bar}")

                print("-" * 50)
                for mode in ("relaxed_order", "strict_order"):
                    n, used = await probe(conn, coll_id, qvec, mode, 40)
                    bar = "█" * n + "·" * (TOP_K - n)
                    print(f"{mode:<16}{40:<11}{used:<7}{TOP_K:<7}{n:<7}{bar}")
            finally:
                await conn.execute("DELETE FROM tenants WHERE slug = 'stress'")
                print("\n压测数据已清理")
    finally:
        await close_pool()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())

"""FakeRetriever。给契约测试和离线开发用。"""
from __future__ import annotations

from uuid import UUID

from quarry.retrieval.base import Hit

class FakeRetriever:
    """返回预设的命中列表，不连数据库。"""

    def __init__(self, canned: list[Hit] | None = None):
        self._canned = list(canned or [])
        self.calls: list[dict] = []          # 记下每次调用，方便测试里断言

    async def search(
        self,
        collection_id: UUID,
        query: str,
        caller_labels: list[str],
        meta_filter: dict | None = None,
        top_k: int = 10,
    ) -> list[Hit]:
        self.calls.append({
            "collection_id": collection_id, "query": query,
            "caller_labels": list(caller_labels),

"""压测混合检索，看并发上升时 QPS 和延迟怎么走。

默认缓存查询向量：每个查询只真实调用一次 embedding，
压测期间不再请求向量化接口，测到的是 jieba + PG 检索的性能。
加 --no-cache 可测端到端耗时（注意接口限流，并发别太高）。
"""
import argparse
import asyncio
import math
import statistics
import sys
import time

from openai.resources.embeddings import AsyncEmbeddings

from quarry.infra.db import acquire, close_pool, init_pool
from quarry.retrieval.pg.searcher import hybrid_search

QUERIES = [
    "兵马俑的门票多少钱", "从机场到市区怎么走", "有什么本地小吃",
    "开放时间是几点", "需要提前预约吗", "住宿大概什么价位",
]

# ---------------- embedding 缓存 ----------------
# 只在压测脚本里临时替换 openai 客户端的 create 方法，不影响业务代码
_orig_create = AsyncEmbeddings.create
_cache: dict[str, object] = {}
_stats = {"hit": 0, "miss": 0}

async def _cached_create(self, *args, **kwargs):
    key = repr((args, sorted(kwargs.items())))
    if key in _cache:
        _stats["hit"] += 1
        return _cache[key]
    _stats["miss"] += 1
    resp = await _orig_create(self, *args, **kwargs)
    _cache[key] = resp
    return resp

def enable_embed_cache():
    AsyncEmbeddings.create = _cached_create

# ---------------- 压测 ----------------
def pct(sorted_vals: list[float], p: float) -> float:
    idx = max(0, math.ceil(len(sorted_vals) * p) - 1)
    return sorted_vals[idx]

async def bench(coll_id, concurrency: int, total: int):
    sem = asyncio.Semaphore(concurrency)
    latencies: list[float] = []
    errors = 0

    async def one(i: int):
        nonlocal errors
        async with sem:
            t0 = time.perf_counter()
            try:
                await hybrid_search(collection_id=coll_id,
                                    query=QUERIES[i % len(QUERIES)],
                                    caller_labels=["public"], top_k=10)
            except Exception as e:
                errors += 1
                if errors == 1:
                    print(f"  首个错误：{type(e).__name__}: {str(e)[:120]}",
                          file=sys.stderr)
                return
            latencies.append((time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000)

    start = time.perf_counter()
    await asyncio.gather(*[one(i) for i in range(total)])
    elapsed = time.perf_counter() - start

    ok = len(latencies)
    if not ok:
        print(f"并发 {concurrency:<4} 全部失败（{errors} 个）")
        return
    latencies.sort()
    print(f"并发 {concurrency:<4} 成功 {ok:<5} 失败 {errors:<4} 耗时 {elapsed:5.2f}s  "
          f"QPS {ok / elapsed:7.1f}  p50 {statistics.median(latencies):7.1f}ms  "
          f"p95 {pct(latencies, 0.95):7.1f}ms  p99 {pct(latencies, 0.99):7.1f}ms")

async def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--no-cache", action="store_true", help="不缓存 embedding，测端到端")
    parser.add_argument("--total", type=int, default=300, help="每档请求数")
    parser.add_argument("--levels", default="1,5,10,20,50", help="并发档位，逗号分隔")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    levels = [int(x) for x in args.levels.split(",")]

    if not args.no_cache:
        enable_embed_cache()

    await init_pool()
    try:
        async with acquire() as conn:
            coll_id = await conn.fetchval(
                "SELECT id FROM collections WHERE slug = 'travel-guide' AND status = 'active'")
        if coll_id is None:
            print("找不到 slug = 'travel-guide' 的活跃集合", file=sys.stderr)
            return

        # 预热：填满缓存，同时让连接池、jieba 词典、PG 缓存都热起来
        for q in QUERIES:
            await hybrid_search(collection_id=coll_id, query=q,
                                caller_labels=["public"], top_k=10)
        mode = "端到端（含 embedding）" if args.no_cache else "已缓存 embedding（只测检索）"
        print(f"模式：{mode}，预热完成\n")

        for c in levels:
            await bench(coll_id, concurrency=c, total=args.total)

        if not args.no_cache:
            print(f"\nembedding 真实调用 {_stats['miss']} 次，缓存命中 {_stats['hit']} 次")
    finally:
        await close_pool()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())

WITH dense AS (
  SELECT chunk_id, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY dist) AS rk, dist
  FROM (
    SELECT chunk_id, embedding <=> $4::halfvec(1024) AS dist
    FROM chunks
    WHERE collection_id = $1 AND level = 1
      AND acl_labels && $2::text[] AND meta @> $3::jsonb
    ORDER BY embedding <=> $4::halfvec(1024)
    LIMIT $6
  ) d
),
sparse AS (
  SELECT chunk_id, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY ts_score DESC) AS rk, ts_score
  FROM (
    SELECT chunk_id, ts_rank_cd(tokens, to_tsquery('simple', $5)) AS ts_score
    FROM chunks
    WHERE collection_id = $1 AND level = 1
      AND acl_labels && $2::text[] AND meta @> $3::jsonb
      AND tokens @@ to_tsquery('simple', $5)
    ORDER BY ts_rank_cd(tokens, to_tsquery('simple', $5)) DESC
    LIMIT $7
  ) s
),
merged AS (
  SELECT chunk_id,
         COALESCE($8::float8 / ($10::int + d.rk), 0)
       + COALESCE($9::float8 / ($10::int + s.rk), 0) AS score,
         d.rk AS dense_rank, s.rk AS sparse_rank
  FROM dense d FULL OUTER JOIN sparse s USING (chunk_id)
),
dense_rows AS (
  SELECT d.rk, round((1 - d.dist)::numeric, 4) AS score,
         c.chunk_id, c.heading_path, left(c.content, 70) AS preview
  FROM dense d
  JOIN chunks c ON c.collection_id = $1 AND c.chunk_id = d.chunk_id
),
sparse_rows AS (
  SELECT s.rk, round(s.ts_score::numeric, 4) AS score,
         c.chunk_id, c.heading_path, left(c.content, 70) AS preview
  FROM sparse s
  JOIN chunks c ON c.collection_id = $1 AND c.chunk_id = s.chunk_id
),
merged_rows AS (
  SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER BY m.score DESC) AS rk,
         round(m.score::numeric, 5) AS score,
         m.dense_rank, m.sparse_rank,
         c.chunk_id, c.heading_path, left(c.content, 70) AS preview
  FROM merged m
  JOIN chunks c ON c.collection_id = $1 AND c.chunk_id = m.chunk_id
  ORDER BY m.score DESC
  LIMIT $11
)
SELECT
  (SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) ORDER BY x.rk) FROM dense_rows  x) AS dense,
  (SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) ORDER BY x.rk) FROM sparse_rows x) AS sparse,
  (SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) ORDER BY x.rk) FROM merged_rows x) AS merged;

"""Reranker 协议。"""
from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Protocol

from quarry.retrieval.base import Hit

class Reranker(Protocol):
    """所有重排实现都要守住三条：

    name: str

    async def rerank(self, query: str, hits: list[Hit], top_k: int) -> list[Hit]: ...

"""重排冒烟测试：三段文本里只有一段相关，而且故意不放在第一位。

通过条件：真的重排过，并且相关的那段被排到了第一。
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import sys
from uuid import uuid4

from quarry.infra.settings import get_settings
from quarry.rerank import get_reranker
from quarry.retrieval.base import Hit

QUERY = "兵马俑博物馆的门票多少钱"
DOCS = [
    (["科技"], "量子计算是计算科学的一个前沿领域。"),
    (["西安", "兵马俑"], "兵马俑博物馆门票 120 元，开放时间 8:30 至 18:00。"),
    (["西安", "美食"], "回民街人均消费约 60 元，晚上八点后最热闹。"),
]

def make_hit(i: int, path: list[str], text: str) -> Hit:
    return Hit(
        chunk_id=f"smoke-{i}", document_id=uuid4(), parent_id=None,
        heading_path=path, content=text, char_start=0, char_end=len(text),
        score=0.0, dense_rank=i + 1, sparse_rank=None,
        dense_score=None, sparse_score=None,
    )

async def main() -> int:
    if get_settings().rerank_backend != "api":
        print("RERANK_BACKEND 不是 api，先按 5.2.3 改好 .env")
        return 1

    reranker = get_reranker()                  # 缺配置会在这里直接报错
    hits = [make_hit(i, path, text) for i, (path, text) in enumerate(DOCS)]
    ranked = await reranker.rerank(QUERY, hits, top_k=3)

    for h in ranked:
        score = "None  " if h.rerank_score is None else f"{h.rerank_score:.4f}"
        print(f"  {score}  {h.content}")

    if not ranked or ranked[0].rerank_score is None:
        print("❌ 没有真正重排：接口调用失败，已按原顺序返回。往上看日志里的 warning。")
        return 1
    if "兵马俑" not in ranked[0].content:
        print("❌ 接口通了，但相关的那段没有排第一。检查 RERANK_MODEL 是不是重排模型。")
        return 1
    print("✅ 重排接口可用")
    return 0

if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(asyncio.run(main()))

"""重排开 / 关对照：同一批候选，重排后的第 1 名原来排第几、多花了多少时间。"""
from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import statistics
import time

from quarry.infra.db import acquire, close_pool, init_pool
from quarry.infra.settings import get_settings
from quarry.rerank import get_reranker
from quarry.retrieval.pg.searcher import hybrid_search

QUERIES = [
    "兵马俑的门票多少钱",
    "从机场到市区怎么走",
    "有什么本地小吃值得尝",
    "景区几点开门",
    "需要提前预约吗",
    "住在哪个区域比较方便",
    "冬天去合适吗",
    "有没有适合带孩子去的地方",
    "当地交通卡怎么买",
    "去下一个城市坐什么车",
]

async def main() -> None:
    s = get_settings()
    reranker = get_reranker()
    if reranker.name == "noop":
        print("RERANK_BACKEND=noop，重排前后会一模一样。先按 5.2.3 改成 api。")
        return

    await init_pool()
    try:
        async with acquire() as conn:
            coll_id = await conn.fetchval(
                "SELECT id FROM collections WHERE slug = 'travel-guide' AND status = 'active'")
        if coll_id is None:
            print("集合 travel-guide 不存在，先跑第三章的 ingest_corpus")
            return

        print(f"候选数 {s.rerank_candidates}\n")
        print("原排名  第1名  重排耗时   查询")
        positions: list[int] = []
        costs: list[float] = []

        for q in QUERIES:
            hits = await hybrid_search(collection_id=coll_id, query=q,
                                       caller_labels=["public"],
                                       top_k=s.rerank_candidates)
            if not hits:
                print(f"   -     -          -   {q}（没有召回）")
                continue
            before = [h.chunk_id for h in hits]

            t0 = time.perf_counter()
            ranked = await reranker.rerank(q, hits, top_k=len(hits))
            cost = (time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000

            # 闸门：没有真正重排过，这张表就没有意义
            if ranked[0].rerank_score is None:
                print(f"\n❌ 「{q}」没有真正重排，对照结果作废。先跑 verify_rerank 排查。")
                return

            pos = before.index(ranked[0].chunk_id) + 1
            positions.append(pos)
            costs.append(cost)
            print(f"{pos:>4}    {'换了' if pos != 1 else '没换'}   {cost:6.0f} ms   {q}")

        if positions:
            changed = sum(1 for p in positions if p != 1)
            print("\n" + "=" * 48)
            print(f"第 1 名被换掉    {changed}/{len(positions)}")
            print(f"重排耗时中位数  {statistics.median(costs):.0f} ms")
    finally:
        await close_pool()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())

"""拒答阈值标定：一组有答案的查询，一组肯定没有答案的，看"召回里最高的余弦分"分不分得开。

用法：
    uv run python -m quarry.scripts.calibrate_abstain            # 只看
    uv run python -m quarry.scripts.calibrate_abstain --write    # 看完写进数据库
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import asyncio

from quarry.infra.db import acquire, close_pool, init_pool
from quarry.retrieval.pg.searcher import hybrid_search

# 按你自己的语料改。第二组的要求是：确信语料里没有答案
HAS_ANSWER = [
    "兵马俑的门票多少钱",
    "从机场到市区怎么走",
    "有什么本地小吃",
    "景区几点开门",
    "推荐住在哪个区域",
    "当地气候怎么样",
]
NO_ANSWER = [
    "量子色动力学的渐近自由",
    "如何配置 Kubernetes 的 Ingress",
    "房贷利率怎么换算",
    "小狗拉肚子吃什么药",
    "asdkjfh qwoieur",
]

async def probe(coll_id, query: str) -> tuple[float | None, float | None]:
    """返回 (第 1 名的融合分, 召回结果里最高的余弦分)。"""
    hits = await hybrid_search(collection_id=coll_id, query=query,
                               caller_labels=["public"], top_k=30)
    if not hits:
        return None, None
    dense = [h.dense_score for h in hits if h.dense_score is not None]
    return hits[0].score, (max(dense) if dense else None)

def _f(x: float | None, digits: int) -> str:
    return "  -   " if x is None else f"{x:.{digits}f}"

async def main() -> None:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--collection", default="travel-guide")
    ap.add_argument("--write", action="store_true",
                    help="把建议阈值写进 collections.abstain_config")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    await init_pool()
    try:
        async with acquire() as conn:
            coll_id = await conn.fetchval(
                "SELECT id FROM collections WHERE slug = $1 AND status = 'active'",
                args.collection)
        if coll_id is None:
            print(f"集合不存在：{args.collection}")
            return

        print("分组      融合分   余弦分   查询")
        pos: list[float] = []
        neg: list[float] = []
        for group, queries, bucket in (("有答案", HAS_ANSWER, pos),
                                       ("没答案", NO_ANSWER, neg)):
            for q in queries:
                fused, dense = await probe(coll_id, q)
                print(f"{group}    {_f(fused, 4)}   {_f(dense, 3)}   {q}")
                if dense is not None:
                    bucket.append(dense)

        if not pos or not neg:
            print("\n有一组拿不到分数：检查集合里有没有数据、EMBED_BACKEND 是不是 api")
            return

        lo, hi = min(pos), max(neg)
        threshold = round((lo + hi) / 2, 2)
        print(f"\n有答案最低 {lo:.3f}，没答案最高 {hi:.3f}，建议阈值 {threshold}")
        if lo <= hi:
            print("⚠️  两组有重叠：先检查重叠的那几条查询选得是否合适，"
                  "第七章会用标注集重新标定")

        if args.write:
            async with acquire() as conn:
                await conn.execute(
                    "UPDATE collections SET abstain_config = $1 WHERE id = $2",
                    {"enabled": True, "min_dense_score": threshold}, coll_id)
            print(f"已写入 {args.collection} 的 abstain_config")
    finally:
        await close_pool()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())

"""跑通第五章的完整链路：打印拒答信号、证据、引用和分段耗时。

用法：uv run python -m quarry.scripts.try_pipeline "问题" [集合短名]
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import sys

from quarry.infra.db import close_pool, init_pool
from quarry.pipeline import search_evidence

def _f(x: float | None, digits: int = 3) -> str:
    return "-" if x is None else f"{x:.{digits}f}"

async def run(query: str, slug: str) -> None:
    await init_pool()
    try:
        r = await search_evidence(slug, query, caller_labels=["public"], top_k=3)
    finally:
        await close_pool()

    a = r.abstain
    print(f"\n查询      {r.query}")
    print(f"拒答建议  {a.should_abstain}（原因 {a.reason}，"
          f"最高余弦分 {_f(a.top_dense_score, 4)}，阈值 {a.threshold}）")
    print(f"重排      {r.debug['rerank_backend']}，真的重排过：{r.debug['reranked']}")
    print(f"候选      {r.debug['candidates']} 条，上下文共 {r.debug['context_chars']} 字\n")

    for i, e in enumerate(r.evidences, 1):
        c = e.citation
        print(f"[{i}] 融合 {e.score:.4f}  余弦 {_f(e.dense_score)}  重排 {_f(e.rerank_score)}")
        print(f"    来源    {c.source_uri}  {' > '.join(c.heading_path)}")
        print(f"    区间    [{c.char_start}, {c.char_end}]  定位粒度 {c.locator_kind}")
        print(f"    链接    {c.url}")
        print(f"    上下文  {e.context_level}，{len(e.context)} 字；同节合并 {e.sibling_hits} 条")
        print(f"    正文    {e.text[:40]}...\n")

    print("耗时（毫秒）")
    for k, v in r.timings.items():
        print(f"    {k:<12}{v}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    q = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "兵马俑的门票多少钱"
    slug = sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else "travel-guide"
    asyncio.run(run(q, slug))

"""第五章新增的红线：整条链路（含父块、邻块回捞）不能绕过权限。"""
import pytest

import quarry.infra.embed as embed
from quarry.infra.db import close_pool, init_pool
from quarry.pipeline import search_evidence
from quarry.rerank import reset_reranker

@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
async def db_pool():
    # pytest-asyncio 每个用例换一个事件循环：
    # 连接池、向量化客户端、重排客户端都要跟着重建
    embed._embedder = None
    reset_reranker()
    await init_pool()
    yield
    await close_pool()

async def test_public_caller_gets_no_corp_evidence():
    """红线 6  public 调用者拿不到企业制度的任何证据。"""
    r = await search_evidence("corp-policy", "住宿标准是多少", caller_labels=["public"])
    assert r.evidences == [], f"权限泄漏：public 拿到了 {len(r.evidences)} 条企业制度证据"

async def test_corp_caller_gets_evidence_with_context():
    """红线 7  有权限的调用者能拿到证据，而且上下文里一定包含命中块本身。"""
    r = await search_evidence("corp-policy", "住宿标准是多少",
                              caller_labels=["org:demo-corp"])
    assert r.evidences, "有权限却拿不到证据，过滤写得过严"
    for e in r.evidences:
        assert e.text in e.context, "上下文里必须包含命中块本身"
：只测"不该看到的看不到"是不够的，把过滤条件写成永远为假也能让第一条通过；必须同时证明"该看到的看得到"。它顺带还验证了一件事：不管上下文降到哪一档，命中块本身都在里面。

"""从打开了事实层的集合里抽取易变数值。

用法：
    uv run python -m quarry.scripts.extract_facts --dry-run --limit 5   # 先看 5 个块，不写库
    uv run python -m quarry.scripts.extract_facts                       # 全量，中断了重跑即可
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import asyncio

from quarry.facts.extract import extract_collection
from quarry.infra.db import acquire, close_pool, init_pool
from quarry.infra.settings import get_settings

async def main() -> None:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--collection", default="travel-guide")
    ap.add_argument("--limit", type=int, help="最多处理多少个需要调模型的块")
    ap.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true", help="只打印结果，不写数据库")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    s = get_settings()
    await init_pool()
    try:
        async with acquire() as conn:
            coll = await conn.fetchrow(
                "SELECT id, facts_enabled FROM collections WHERE slug = $1 AND status = 'active'",
                args.collection)
        if coll is None or not coll["facts_enabled"]:
            print(f"集合 {args.collection} 不存在，或者没有打开 facts_enabled（见 6.2.3）")
            return
        st = await extract_collection(s, coll["id"], limit=args.limit, dry_run=args.dry_run)
    finally:
        await close_pool()

    print("\n" + "=" * 50)
    print(f"待处理父块    {st.todo}（粗筛跳过 {st.skipped}）")
    print(f"调用模型      {st.called}，失败 {st.failed}")
    print(f"抽到提及      {st.mentions}")
    if st.dropped:
        print("丢弃          " + "，".join(f"{k} {v}" for k, v in st.dropped.items()))
    if args.dry_run:
        print("（dry-run，没有写入数据库）")
    if st.called and st.failed == st.called:
        print("❌ 模型调用全部失败，往上看日志里的报错")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())

"""从打开了事实层的集合里抽取易变数值。

"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import asyncio

from quarry.facts.extract import extract_collection
from quarry.infra.db import acquire, close_pool, init_pool
from quarry.infra.settings import get_settings

async def main() -> None:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--collection", default="travel-guide")
    ap.add_argument("--limit", type=int, help="最多处理多少个需要调模型的块")
    ap.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true", help="只打印结果，不写数据库")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    s = get_settings()
    await init_pool()
    try:
        async with acquire() as conn:
            coll = await conn.fetchrow(
                "SELECT id, facts_enabled FROM collections WHERE slug = $1 AND status = 'active'",
                args.collection)
        if coll is None or not coll["facts_enabled"]:
            print(f"集合 {args.collection} 不存在，或者没有打开 facts_enabled（见 6.2.3）")
            return
        st = await extract_collection(s, coll["id"], limit=args.limit, dry_run=args.dry_run)
    finally:
        await close_pool()

    print("\n" + "=" * 50)
    print(f"待处理父块    {st.todo}（粗筛跳过 {st.skipped}）")
    print(f"调用模型      {st.called}，失败 {st.failed}")
    print(f"抽到提及      {st.mentions}")
    if st.dropped:
        print("丢弃          " + "，".join(f"{k} {v}" for k, v in st.dropped.items()))
    if args.dry_run:
        print("（dry-run，没有写入数据库）")
    if st.called and st.failed == st.called:
        print("❌ 模型调用全部失败，往上看日志里的报错")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())

"""抽样核对：随机取 N 条提及，连同前后文一起打印，人工判断抽得对不对。

用法：uv run python -m quarry.scripts.review_facts [--n 20] [--collection travel-guide]
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import asyncio

from quarry.facts.contract import ATTRIBUTES
from quarry.infra.db import acquire, close_pool, init_pool

_SQL = """
SELECT m.entity_name, m.attribute, m.qualifier, m.value, m.quote,
       m.span_start, m.span_end, c.content
FROM fact_mentions m
JOIN chunks c ON c.collection_id = m.collection_id AND c.chunk_id = m.chunk_id
JOIN collections k ON k.id = m.collection_id
WHERE k.slug = $1
ORDER BY random()
LIMIT $2
"""

async def main() -> None:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--collection", default="travel-guide")
    ap.add_argument("--n", type=int, default=20)
    args = ap.parse_args()

    await init_pool()
    try:
        async with acquire() as conn:
            rows = await conn.fetch(_SQL, args.collection, args.n)
    finally:
        await close_pool()

    if not rows:
        print("fact_mentions 里没有数据，先跑 extract_facts")
        return
    for i, r in enumerate(rows, 1):
        text, s, e = r["content"], r["span_start"], r["span_end"]
        # 位置是代码找的，这里再核对一遍：对不上说明写库时出了错
        flag = "" if text[s:e] == r["quote"] else "  ❌ 偏移和原文对不上"
        before = text[max(0, s - 25):s].replace("\n", " ")
        after = text[e:e + 25].replace("\n", " ")
        print(f"[{i:>2}] {r['entity_name']} · {ATTRIBUTES[r['attribute']]} · "
              f"{r['qualifier']} = {r['value']}{flag}")
        print(f"     …{before}【{text[s:e]}】{after}…\n")
    print("逐条判断：实体、属性、季节、值四项都对才算对。准确率 = 对的条数 / 总条数。")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())

"""导入官方数据：CSV 整体替换这个集合的官方值，然后打印核验状态统计。

用法：uv run python -m quarry.scripts.import_official_facts [--file official/travel-guide.csv]
文件名（不含扩展名）就是集合短名。
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import asyncio
from pathlib import Path

from quarry.facts.contract import ATTRIBUTES
from quarry.facts.official import coverage, load_csv, replace_facts
from quarry.infra.db import acquire, close_pool, init_pool
from quarry.infra.settings import get_settings

async def main() -> None:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--file", default="official/travel-guide.csv")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    path = Path(args.file)
    rows, errors = load_csv(path)
    if errors:
        print(f"❌ {path} 有 {len(errors)} 处错误，一行都没有导入：")
        for err in errors:
            print("   " + err)
        return

    s = get_settings()
    await init_pool()
    try:
        async with acquire() as conn:
            coll_id = await conn.fetchval(
                "SELECT id FROM collections WHERE slug = $1 AND status = 'active'",
                path.stem)
            if coll_id is None:
                print(f"集合 {path.stem} 不存在：文件名要和集合短名一致")
                return
            await replace_facts(conn, coll_id, rows)
            report = await coverage(conn, coll_id, s.fact_ttl_days)
    finally:
        await close_pool()

    c = report["counts"]
    print(f"已导入官方值    {len(rows)} 条\n")
    print(f"正文提及        {sum(c.values())} 条")
    print(f"  verified      {c['verified']}")
    print(f"  expired       {c['expired']}")
    print(f"  unverified    {c['unverified']}")

    if report["conflicts"]:
        print(f"\n正文与官方不一致（{len(report['conflicts'])} 项）：")
        for (name, attribute, qualifier, written, official), n in report["conflicts"].items():
            print(f"  {name} {ATTRIBUTES[attribute]}·{qualifier}  "
                  f"正文 {written} → 官方 {official}（{n} 处）")
    if report["expired"]:
        print(f"\n超过 {s.fact_ttl_days} 天没有重新核实的官方值：")
        for r in report["expired"]:
            print(f"  {r['entity_name']} {ATTRIBUTES[r['attribute']]}·{r['qualifier']}"
                  f"  核实于 {r['verified_at']}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())

"""跑通检索链路：打印拒答信号、证据、引用、事实和分段耗时。

用法：uv run python -m quarry.scripts.try_pipeline "问题" [集合短名] [--no-facts]
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import sys

from quarry.infra.db import close_pool, init_pool
from quarry.pipeline import search_evidence

def _f(x: float | None, digits: int = 3) -> str:
    return "-" if x is None else f"{x:.{digits}f}"

async def run(query: str, slug: str, use_facts: bool) -> None:
    await init_pool()
    try:
        r = await search_evidence(slug, query, caller_labels=["public"], top_k=3,
                                  use_facts=use_facts)
    finally:
        await close_pool()

    a = r.abstain
    print(f"\n查询      {r.query}")
    print(f"拒答建议  {a.should_abstain}（原因 {a.reason}，"
          f"最高余弦分 {_f(a.top_dense_score, 4)}，阈值 {a.threshold}）")
    print(f"重排      {r.debug['rerank_backend']}，真的重排过：{r.debug['reranked']}")
    print(f"事实层    {'开' if r.debug['facts_enabled'] else '关'}")
    print(f"候选      {r.debug['candidates']} 条，上下文共 {r.debug['context_chars']} 字\n")

    for i, e in enumerate(r.evidences, 1):
        c = e.citation
        print(f"[{i}] 融合 {e.score:.4f}  余弦 {_f(e.dense_score)}  重排 {_f(e.rerank_score)}")
        print(f"    来源    {c.source_uri}  {' > '.join(c.heading_path)}")
        print(f"    区间    [{c.char_start}, {c.char_end}]  定位粒度 {c.locator_kind}"
              f"  核实日期 {c.verified_at}")
        print(f"    上下文  {e.context_level}，{len(e.context)} 字；同节合并 {e.sibling_hits} 条")
        for fact in e.facts:
            when = f"核实于 {fact.verified_at}" if fact.verified_at else "未核实"
            old = [w for w in fact.written_values if w != fact.value]
            note = f"（正文写的是 {'、'.join(old)}）" if old else ""
            print(f"    事实    {fact.ref} {fact.entity} {fact.label}·{fact.qualifier} = "
                  f"{fact.value}  {fact.status}，{when}{note}")
        mark = e.context.find("〔F")
        if mark >= 0:
            snippet = e.context[max(0, mark - 20):mark + 40].replace("\n", " ")
            print(f"    遮蔽后  …{snippet}…")
        preview = e.text[:40].replace("\n", " ")
        print(f"    正文    {preview}...\n")

    print("耗时（毫秒）")
    for k, v in r.timings.items():
        print(f"    {k:<12}{v}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    args = [a for a in sys.argv[1:] if a != "--no-facts"]
    question = args[0] if args else "兵马俑的门票多少钱"
    collection = args[1] if len(args) > 1 else "travel-guide"
    asyncio.run(run(question, collection, use_facts="--no-facts" not in sys.argv))

"""事实层的单元测试：不连数据库、不调模型。"""
from datetime import date

from quarry.facts.attach import FactMasker, verified_date
from quarry.facts.contract import check_item, normalize_value

PARENT = "兵马俑博物馆门票 120 元，旺季开放时间 8:30 至 18:00。回民街人均 60 元。"

def mention(quote, attribute, written, official=None, verified=None):
    start = PARENT.index(quote)
    return {"chunk_id": "P1", "span_start": start, "span_end": start + len(quote),
            "entity_name": "兵马俑博物馆", "attribute": attribute, "qualifier": "旺季",
            "written_value": written,
            "official_name": "秦始皇帝陵博物院" if official else None,
            "official_value": official, "verified_at": verified, "source_url": None}

def test_mask_then_finalize():
    rows = [mention("120 元", "ticket_price", "120",
                    official="150", verified=date(2026, 9, 1)),
            mention("8:30 至 18:00", "open_hours", "08:30-18:00")]
    masker = FactMasker(rows, ttl_days=90, today=date(2026, 9, 17))
    [ctx], [facts] = masker.finalize([masker.mask("P1", PARENT)])

    assert "120" not in ctx and "8:30" not in ctx
    assert "〔F1 门票价格〕" in ctx and "〔F2 开放时间〕" in ctx
    assert "60 元" in ctx                                     # 没抽取的数值保持原样
    assert [f.value for f in facts] == ["150", "08:30-18:00"]
    assert [f.status for f in facts] == ["verified", "unverified"]
    assert facts[0].written_values == ["120"]
    assert verified_date(facts) is None                       # 有未核实的数值，卡片不显示日期

def test_mask_child_window_with_offset():
    masker = FactMasker([mention("8:30 至 18:00", "open_hours", "08:30-18:00")],
                        ttl_days=90)
    offset = PARENT.index("旺季")
    child = PARENT[offset:offset + 20]
    assert "〔F1 开放时间〕" in masker.mask("P1", child, offset=offset)
    assert masker.mask("P1", PARENT[:10]) == PARENT[:10]      # 提及不在这段文字里，原样返回

def test_expired_status_and_card_date():
    rows = [mention("120 元", "ticket_price", "120",
                    official="150", verified=date(2026, 1, 1))]
    masker = FactMasker(rows, ttl_days=90, today=date(2026, 9, 17))
    _, [facts] = masker.finalize([masker.mask("P1", PARENT)])
    assert facts[0].status == "expired"
    assert verified_date(facts) == date(2026, 1, 1)

def test_contract_normalizes_and_rejects():
    assert normalize_value("open_hours", "8:30至18:00") == "08:30-18:00"
    assert normalize_value("open_hours", "18:00-8:30") is None
    assert normalize_value("ticket_price", "免费") == "0"
    assert normalize_value("ticket_price", "120元") == "120"
    too_long = {"entity": "某景点", "attribute": "ticket_price", "value": "120",
                "quote": "这一整句话都被模型当成了原文片段，太长了，"
                         "遮蔽时会误伤一大段，门票 120 元"}
    assert check_item(too_long) == (None, "原文片段不合规")

"""从语料里生成评测问题草稿，写成 CSV，供人工筛选。

用法：uv run python -m quarry.scripts.make_eval_draft [--n 40] [--collection travel-guide]
生成的是草稿，必须人工过一遍才能当标注集用。
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import asyncio
import csv
import json
from pathlib import Path

from quarry.facts.extract import make_client            # 草稿用第六章配的 FACT_MODEL
from quarry.infra.db import acquire, close_pool, init_pool
from quarry.infra.logging import get_logger
from quarry.infra.settings import get_settings

log = get_logger()

SYSTEM_PROMPT = """你在为一个旅行问答系统准备评测问题。用户会给出一段攻略正文和它的标题路径。
提出一个真实用户可能会问、而且只靠这段正文就能回答的问题，只输出 JSON：
{"query": "问题"}

规则：
1. 问题里要出现具体的地名或景点名，不要用"这里""该景点"这样的指代。
2. 不要出现"这段""本文""上文"之类的词。
3. 问一个具体的信息点（价格、时间、怎么去、有什么），不要问"介绍一下"。
4. 不超过 20 个字。"""

_BLOCKS_SQL = """
SELECT c.chunk_id, c.heading_path, c.content
FROM chunks c
JOIN documents d ON d.id = c.document_id
WHERE c.collection_id = $1 AND c.level = 0 AND d.status = 'ready'
  AND char_length(c.content) >= 200
ORDER BY random()
LIMIT $2
"""

async def main() -> None:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--collection", default="travel-guide")
    ap.add_argument("--n", type=int, default=40)
    args = ap.parse_args()

    s = get_settings()
    client = make_client(s)
    await init_pool()
    try:
        async with acquire() as conn:
            coll_id = await conn.fetchval(
                "SELECT id FROM collections WHERE slug = $1 AND status = 'active'",
                args.collection)
            if coll_id is None:
                print(f"集合 {args.collection} 不存在")
                return
            blocks = await conn.fetch(_BLOCKS_SQL, coll_id, args.n)
    finally:
        await close_pool()

    sem = asyncio.Semaphore(s.fact_concurrency)
    rows: list[dict] = []

    async def one(b) -> None:
        try:
            async with sem:
                resp = await client.chat.completions.create(
                    model=s.fact_model,
                    messages=[
                        {"role": "system", "content": SYSTEM_PROMPT},
                        {"role": "user",
                         "content": f"标题路径：{' > '.join(b['heading_path'])}\n\n"
                                    f"正文：\n{b['content'][:2000]}"},
                    ],
                    response_format={"type": "json_object"},
                    temperature=0.3,
                    extra_body={"enable_thinking": False},
                )
            query = json.loads(resp.choices[0].message.content or "{}").get("query", "").strip()
            if len(query) >= 4:
                rows.append({"query": query, "kind": "answerable",
                             "gold_chunks": b["chunk_id"],
                             "note": " > ".join(b["heading_path"])})
        except Exception as e:
            log.warning("生成失败 {}：{!r}", b["chunk_id"][:8], e)

    await asyncio.gather(*(one(b) for b in blocks))

    path = Path("eval") / f"{args.collection}.draft.csv"
    path.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    with path.open("w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
        w = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=["query", "kind", "gold_chunks", "note"])
        w.writeheader()
        w.writerows(sorted(rows, key=lambda r: r["note"]))

    print(f"\n取了 {len(blocks)} 个父块，生成 {len(rows)} 条草稿 → {path}")
    if not rows:
        print("❌ 一条都没生成，先看日志里的报错")
    else:
        print("下一步：人工筛一遍（见 7.2.5），保留 30 条左右，再补上无答案问题")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())

"""标注集：问题 ID 的算法，以及 CSV 的读取与校验。"""
from __future__ import annotations

import csv
import hashlib
from pathlib import Path

COLUMNS = ["query", "kind", "gold_chunks", "note"]
KINDS = ("answerable", "unanswerable")

def qid_of(query: str) -> str:
    """问题 ID 由问题内容算出：同一个问题反复导入，ID 不变，历史结果还能对得上。"""
    return hashlib.sha256(query.strip().encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:16]

def load_csv(path: Path) -> tuple[list[dict], list[str]]:
    """读取并逐行校验。返回 (合规的行, 错误信息)；有任何错误都不应该导入。"""
    rows: list[dict] = []
    errors: list[str] = []
    seen: dict[str, int] = {}

    with path.open(encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="") as f:
        reader = csv.DictReader(f)
        if reader.fieldnames != COLUMNS:
            return [], [f"表头必须是：{','.join(COLUMNS)}"]
        for line, r in enumerate(reader, start=2):
            cell = {k: (r.get(k) or "").strip() for k in COLUMNS}
            query, kind = cell["query"], cell["kind"]
            gold = [g.strip() for g in cell["gold_chunks"].split("|") if g.strip()]

            problems = [msg for bad, msg in [
                (len(query) < 4, "问题太短"),
                (kind not in KINDS, "kind 只能是 " + " / ".join(KINDS)),
                (kind == "answerable" and not gold, "有答案的问题必须写 gold_chunks"),
                (kind == "unanswerable" and bool(gold), "无答案的问题不能写 gold_chunks"),
                (query in seen, f"和第 {seen.get(query)} 行的问题重复"),
            ] if bad]
            if problems:
                errors.append(f"第 {line} 行：" + "；".join(problems))
                continue

            seen[query] = line
            rows.append({"qid": qid_of(query), "query": query, "kind": kind,
                         "gold_chunks": gold, "note": cell["note"] or None})
    return rows, errors

"""导入标注集：CSV 整体替换这个集合的评测问题。

用法：uv run python -m quarry.scripts.import_eval_set [--file eval/travel-guide.csv]
文件名（不含扩展名）就是集合短名。
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import asyncio
from pathlib import Path

from quarry.eval.dataset import load_csv
from quarry.infra.db import acquire, close_pool, init_pool

async def main() -> None:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--file", default="eval/travel-guide.csv")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    path = Path(args.file)
    rows, errors = load_csv(path)
    if errors:
        print(f"❌ {path} 有 {len(errors)} 处错误，一条都没有导入：")
        for err in errors:
            print("   " + err)
        return

    await init_pool()
    try:
        async with acquire() as conn:
            coll_id = await conn.fetchval(
                "SELECT id FROM collections WHERE slug = $1 AND status = 'active'",
                path.stem)
            if coll_id is None:
                print(f"集合 {path.stem} 不存在：文件名要和集合短名一致")
                return

            # 金块必须是这个集合里真实存在的父块，否则召回率会被算错
            gold = sorted({g for r in rows for g in r["gold_chunks"]})
            alive = {r["chunk_id"] for r in await conn.fetch(
                "SELECT chunk_id FROM chunks WHERE collection_id = $1"
                " AND chunk_id = ANY($2::text[]) AND level = 0", coll_id, gold)}
            missing = [(r["query"], g) for r in rows for g in r["gold_chunks"]
                       if g not in alive]
            if missing:
                print(f"❌ {len(missing)} 个金块在库里找不到，一条都没有导入：")
                for query, g in missing[:10]:
                    print(f"   {g[:12]}…  {query}")
                print("   语料重新接入之后块 ID 会变，重新生成草稿即可")
                return

            async with conn.transaction():
                await conn.execute(
                    "DELETE FROM eval_queries WHERE collection_id = $1", coll_id)
                await conn.executemany(
                    """INSERT INTO eval_queries (collection_id, qid, query, kind,
                                                 gold_chunks, note)
                       VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6)""",
                    [(coll_id, r["qid"], r["query"], r["kind"], r["gold_chunks"], r["note"])
                     for r in rows])
    finally:
        await close_pool()

    answerable = [r for r in rows if r["kind"] == "answerable"]
    print(f"已导入 {len(rows)} 条：有答案 {len(answerable)}，"
          f"无答案 {len(rows) - len(answerable)}，金块 {len(gold)} 个")
    if len(answerable) < 20 or len(rows) - len(answerable) < 5:
        print("⚠️ 建议至少 20 条有答案、5 条无答案，指标才有参考价值")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())

"""跑一次评测，把配置和指标存进 eval_runs。

用法：
    uv run python -m quarry.scripts.run_eval --label baseline --no-rerank --no-facts
    uv run python -m quarry.scripts.run_eval --label full --judge
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import asyncio

from quarry.eval.metrics import render
from quarry.eval.runner import run_eval
from quarry.infra.db import acquire, close_pool, init_pool
from quarry.infra.settings import get_settings

async def main() -> None:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--collection", default="travel-guide")
    ap.add_argument("--label", required=True, help="这次跑的名字，比如 baseline、rerank-on")
    ap.add_argument("--top-k", type=int)
    ap.add_argument("--no-rerank", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--no-facts", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--judge", action="store_true", help="调裁判模型评证据够不够，会花钱")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    s = get_settings()
    await init_pool()
    try:
        async with acquire() as conn:
            coll_id = await conn.fetchval(
                "SELECT id FROM collections WHERE slug = $1 AND status = 'active'",
                args.collection)
        if coll_id is None:
            print(f"集合 {args.collection} 不存在")
            return
        run_id, metrics, _ = await run_eval(
            s, args.collection, coll_id, args.label,
            top_k=args.top_k or s.eval_top_k,
            use_rerank=not args.no_rerank, use_facts=not args.no_facts,
            use_judge=args.judge)
    finally:
        await close_pool()

    print(f"\n运行 {run_id}")
    print(render(metrics))
    print(f"\n对照另一次运行：uv run python -m quarry.scripts.compare_eval "
          f"--base 别的label --new {args.label}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())

"""裁判模型：判断一组证据够不够回答这个问题。它只评证据，不写答案。"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json

from openai import AsyncOpenAI

from quarry.infra.settings import Settings

VERDICTS = ("supported", "partial", "unsupported")
MAX_CONTEXT_CHARS = 4000

SYSTEM_PROMPT = """你是检索结果的评审员。用户会给出一个问题和检索到的证据。
判断这些证据够不够回答这个问题，只输出 JSON：
{"verdict": "supported", "reason": "一句话说明"}

verdict 只能是下面三个值之一：
- supported：证据里有直接回答问题的信息
- partial：证据沾边，但缺关键信息，照着回答会不完整
- unsupported：证据回答不了这个问题

注意：
1. 只看证据够不够，不要用你自己的知识补充。
2. 证据里形如〔F1 门票价格〕的占位符，表示平台已经单独提供了这个数值，按"已经给出"处理。
3. reason 不超过 30 个字。"""

def make_client(s: Settings) -> AsyncOpenAI:
    key = s.judge_api_key.get_secret_value() or s.llm_api_key.get_secret_value()
    if not s.judge_model or not s.judge_base_url:
        raise ValueError("先在 .env 里配置 JUDGE_MODEL 和 JUDGE_BASE_URL")
    if not key or "REPLACE-ME" in key:
        raise ValueError("没有可用的 API Key：先填好 LLM_API_KEY，或单独填 JUDGE_API_KEY")
    return AsyncOpenAI(base_url=s.judge_base_url, api_key=key,
                       timeout=s.judge_timeout_s, max_retries=2)

async def judge_one(client: AsyncOpenAI, model: str, query: str,
                    contexts: list[str]) -> tuple[str | None, str]:
    """返回 (verdict, reason)。模型给出的 verdict 不在清单里时，返回 (None, 原因)。"""
    evidence = "\n---\n".join(contexts)[:MAX_CONTEXT_CHARS]
    resp = await client.chat.completions.create(
        model=model,
        messages=[
            {"role": "system", "content": SYSTEM_PROMPT},
            {"role": "user", "content": f"问题：{query}\n\n证据：\n{evidence}"},
        ],
        response_format={"type": "json_object"},
        temperature=0,
        extra_body={"enable_thinking": False},
    )
    data = json.loads(resp.choices[0].message.content or "{}")
    verdict = data.get("verdict") if isinstance(data, dict) else None
    reason = str(data.get("reason", ""))[:60] if isinstance(data, dict) else ""
    if verdict not in VERDICTS:
        return None, "裁判输出不合规"
    return verdict, reason

"""压测：并发跑标注集里的问题，统计延迟分位数和各阶段耗时。

用法：uv run python -m quarry.scripts.bench [--concurrency 4] [--requests 60] [--no-rerank]
并发从 2 起步慢慢加，别把厂商接口的限流打爆。
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import asyncio
import time

from quarry.eval.metrics import pad, percentile
from quarry.infra.db import acquire, close_pool, init_pool
from quarry.infra.settings import get_settings
from quarry.pipeline import search_evidence

STAGES = ["lookup_ms", "recall_ms", "rerank_ms", "expand_ms", "facts_ms", "assemble_ms"]

async def main() -> None:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--collection", default="travel-guide")
    ap.add_argument("--concurrency", type=int, default=4)
    ap.add_argument("--requests", type=int, default=60)
    ap.add_argument("--no-rerank", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--no-facts", action="store_true")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    s = get_settings()
    await init_pool()
    try:
        async with acquire() as conn:
            coll_id = await conn.fetchval(
                "SELECT id FROM collections WHERE slug = $1 AND status = 'active'",
                args.collection)
            queries = [r["query"] for r in await conn.fetch(
                "SELECT query FROM eval_queries WHERE collection_id = $1"
                " AND kind = 'answerable'", coll_id)]
        if not queries:
            print("标注集里没有有答案的问题，先跑 7.2 的导入脚本")
            return

        totals: list[float] = []
        stages: dict[str, list[float]] = {k: [] for k in STAGES}
        failures = 0
        counter = 0
        lock = asyncio.Lock()

        async def worker() -> None:
            nonlocal counter, failures
            while True:
                async with lock:
                    if counter >= args.requests:
                        return
                    query = queries[counter % len(queries)]
                    counter += 1
                started = time.perf_counter()
                try:
                    r = await search_evidence(args.collection, query,
                                              caller_labels=["public"],
                                              top_k=s.eval_top_k,
                                              use_rerank=not args.no_rerank,
                                              use_facts=not args.no_facts)
                except Exception:
                    failures += 1
                    continue
                totals.append((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)
                for k in STAGES:
                    if k in r.timings:
                        stages[k].append(r.timings[k])

        wall = time.perf_counter()
        await asyncio.gather(*(worker() for _ in range(args.concurrency)))
        wall = time.perf_counter() - wall
    finally:
        await close_pool()

    print(f"\n并发 {args.concurrency}，请求 {len(totals)} 成功 / {failures} 失败，"
          f"耗时 {wall:.1f} 秒，吞吐 {len(totals) / max(wall, 0.001):.1f} 次/秒")
    print(f"重排 {'关' if args.no_rerank else '开'}，"
          f"事实层 {'关' if args.no_facts else '开'}\n")
    print("  " + pad("阶段", 16) + f"{'P50':>9}{'P95':>9}{'P99':>9}")
    for k in STAGES + ["合计"]:
        values = totals if k == "合计" else stages[k]
        if values:
            print("  " + pad(k, 16) + f"{percentile(values, 50):>9}"
                                      f"{percentile(values, 95):>9}"
                                      f"{percentile(values, 99):>9}")
    if percentile(totals, 95) > 800:
        print("\n⚠️ P95 超过 800 毫秒的预算，看看哪一段最贵（一般是重排）")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())

"""评测指标的单元测试：不连数据库、不调模型。"""
from dataclasses import dataclass
from uuid import uuid4

from quarry.eval.dataset import load_csv, qid_of
from quarry.eval.metrics import QueryResult, gold_rank, percentile, summarize

DOC = uuid4()

@dataclass
class FakeCitation:
    document_id: object
    char_start: int
    char_end: int

@dataclass
class FakeEvidence:
    citation: FakeCitation

def ev(doc, start, end):
    return FakeEvidence(FakeCitation(doc, start, end))

def test_gold_rank_matches_by_containment():
    gold = [(DOC, 100, 400)]
    # 第 1 条是别的文档，第 2 条落在金块区间里
    assert gold_rank([ev(uuid4(), 120, 200), ev(DOC, 120, 200)], gold) == 2
    assert gold_rank([ev(DOC, 500, 600)], gold) is None      # 同一文档但不在区间里
    assert gold_rank([ev(DOC, 380, 420)], gold) is None      # 越过右边界，不算命中
    assert gold_rank([ev(DOC, 100, 400)], gold) == 1         # 正好等于金块区间
    assert gold_rank([ev(DOC, 120, 200)], []) is None        # 无答案问题没有金块

def test_percentile_uses_nearest_rank():
    assert percentile([10, 20, 30, 40], 50) == 20
    assert percentile([10, 20, 30, 40], 95) == 40
    assert percentile([], 95) == 0.0

def test_summarize():
    items = [
        QueryResult("a", "问题1", "answerable", 1, False, 3, 100.0, judge="supported"),
        QueryResult("b", "问题2", "answerable", 2, False, 3, 200.0, judge="partial"),
        QueryResult("c", "问题3", "answerable", None, True, 0, 300.0),
        QueryResult("d", "问题4", "unanswerable", None, True, 0, 400.0),
    ]
